content: Claude Code plugin/skill packaging (official docs + multiple corroborating sources): plugin root .claude-plugin/plugin.json (name kebab-case required, version/description/author; names claude-*/anthropic-* rejected) + default dirs commands/ agents/ skills/ hooks/ + root .mcp.json; component paths relative ./;  for plugin-internal refs (plugin copied to cache, no ../ escapes); claude plugin validate checks manifest+frontmatter. Marketplace: repo .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (name/owner/plugins; entry name+source: relative|github|url|git-subdir|npm|pip, ref/sha pinning; strict:false + skills array for skill-only packs). Install: claude plugin marketplace add owner/repo -> claude plugin install name@marketplace; debug --plugin-dir, /reload-plugins. SKILL.md: skills/<name>/SKILL.md, frontmatter name (lowercase-hyphen <=64), description drives auto-invocation (~1536 char budget with when_to_use), allowed-tools, disable-model-invocation, context:fork, model, argument-hint; agentskills.io open standard; cross-agent npx skills add.
